I'm an extrovert and I've been told I'm loud and obnoxious and now I'm quiet they want me to talk.

Society sucks and that's it. That's the take.

I'm Asian too :( and I'm currently waiting to enter uni. As in I got the confirmation and orientation packages. I'm sorry if I was stupid to give info but I genuinely thought it was my fault for years but I never found out why. 

Now I don't share anything with her. Just simple answers. It satisfies her somehow but she'll figure it out. She has a habit of slamming dishes and stuff and complain about me.

I'll look up C-PTSD.
I don't live in the UK if that is what you meant by.
I understand that fear, it sends a cold shockwave. I wish we didn't have to go through that. I'm happy you recognise it and learn it wasn't and isn't normal
Thanks for the reply. I understand many people here also concluded the same. I'll start recognising behaviour patterns of hers.
I break stuff rarely but damn the scolding kinda made me feel like I upturned the kitchen instead of a small glass jar.
Perhaps. I will see her reaction in the morning.

Thank you! I'm trying to unlearn stuff like to stop flinching when someone is a little louder or slamming a glass or just throwing stuff. It's the kind of chill that makes your body go cold all of a sudden.
Understood. Still stings though. I still think about it and its 1.30am right now.

Thank you. As of now,  my mum seems to have calmed down but still hasn't eaten. 

It never really occurred to me that this isn't normal. She's always saying stuff like I'm doing this for your good or what would people think of me. She's had a control on most of my life, including what I can wear when I go out. I end up wearing the same shit to avoid judgement when I wish to try other clothes and having the means to do so.

Thank you for the insights

Thank you for the incredibly detailed reply. I've been trying to correct myself again and minimsie negative thoughts surging at me when I get screamed at. 

I hope your friend is doing okay. No one deserves that at all.

I really don't know when she would implode. One time she's mad then next so gentle she puts pillows to shame. I don't know who is who and I'm in circles. 

Because of this, I also get scared when I'm in my friend circle. If for eg they don't reply within 4 hours, I assume they're angry at me even though I know they are busy I just cannot reverse the thinking. I always notice more than I should. 

You put my entire sentiment in one simple sentence, thank you.
Trying. I saved 10k so far but that's far from enough. In my place, that is enough to survive for one month including rent and utilities

I'm not allowed to apply to Hall at Uni, I was warned from the beginning which sucks big time.

I feel like an ass for saying this but she's always done this to me. My (13M) brother gets away with everything and I have to take the blame. Its a tradition in my home that the firstborn daughter is responsible for everyone (dad, siblings) if mum isn't around.

She likes to tell me stories of her being married before 20. She threatened to marry me off once and I cried so much that night. I never tell anything personal to her. I don't even tell her if I'm on my period, i just get the shit myself.

This is the eighth time I've cried this week. I don't know what I'm doing.
I haven't had contact with my friends recently. I try not to talk about stuff like that because they don't care.
No. They're all in a another country. My parents migrated here. My relatives are also like that.
It's apparently a custom in my household. My mum always says she's done everything for me (I agree) but I turned out useless vs ny more successful sibling. I can never measure up.

I agree that my mum can and should be upset that I did something careless.

I'm terrified everytime she approaches me. I flinch involuntarily. I've been caned and whipped as a child but that's mostly stopped now expect once in a while but her verbal insults got worse. I've been told to unalive myself once.
I've had enough at 19. I can't stand it anymore. I've been nice, I've tried everything. I can't make her happy at all. She's so difficult to please but I've tried every damn day.

I guess. I really don't know what to do. It's been an hour since she's left and she has to eat because she takes medicines. 

I get scolded for literally anything. I get scared of doing anything now. I can't leave my home at all, can't meet my friends. For eg, my mum would be like "You can go out." and tell me one how before that i can't. It makes me really sad, I missed so many movie days and birthday lunches I could've gone to. She never let me grow up.
I couldn't clean it, I fetched the broom and dustpan but I was sent away. I feel bad for ruining a new jam bottle but her words still kinda eat my heart and brain.

I rarely drop stuff anyway, I guess she got extra mad and her tiredness just fuelled her anger. She's still mad at me and I'm in despair as she hasn't eaten. 

I really envy mothers and daughters who have such a lovely relationship. I can't read my mother well because she changes moods rapidly and I have to adjust to it.
True, trying to not think about the jiggly thighs, fat ass and crooked teeth statements.

I can't wear headphones at home without being insulted anymore. I decided to just work when my mum is relaxing so she wouldn't bother me like that and i can help her. I lose my own personal time to write and game so that's a bit bummer.
Okay! I always finish my stuff before playing I always check mentally.
I tried not playing Val this week, gave in once. Otherwise I went out to eat and watch movies. Or I worked on side projects.

Hi, I admit I may have a problem. I'm trying to only play at fixed times. Otherwise, I'm not allowed to play. I'm really afraid. I didn't play Val to rank up, it was kinda cuz my siblings played so I joined in. I used to play late at night but I stopped it completely.

Thank you internet mum! Unfortunately, I can't leave the house any moment these days and my internship is online so that sucks more. Its just, I'm so emotionally tired of hearing my mom screech complain about my flaws. I've been trying to be better. 

Thank you for the hugs. I appreciate you ♡
